hotels.title: Boutique Colorado Rocky Mountain Escape with Stylish Rooftop & Onsite Taproom
hotels.description: Outdoor adventures, acclaimed craft beer and a breathtaking location at the base of the Rocky Mountains, The Eddy Taproom & Hotel offers an exceptional escape for gourmands and adventurists seeking an inviting atmosphere amid Colorado’s picturesque scenery. Designed for the modern explorer, this boutique hotel features 49 artistically styled rooms. Spend fun-filled days hiking and e-biking through the surrounding landscape, then celebrate your efforts at this trendy retreat. Tuck into a mouthwatering BBQ feast at Truck Eddy, sip a hand-crafted cocktail or signature beer at the onsite taproom or bask in the glow of a fire pit on the private rooftop, where sweeping mountain sunsets await.
